message:
Thanks for getting in touch, Macy. To obtain a buildings insurance quotation for your rental flat at 101 Birch Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 1ZZ, could you please provide the following details:

1. Rebuild/reinstatement value of the property (not market value)

5. Confirmation that it will be let (and whether furnished or unfurnished)
6. Tenant type (e.g., professional let, DSS, students, holiday let)
7. Any previous claims history (last 5 years) on this property
8. Any unspent criminal convictions for you or any co-owners
9. Whether the property has any flood risk history or has had subsidence/flooding before
10. Security features (e.g., alarms, locks)
11. Current insurer (if any) and whether cover is continuous or lapsed

Once I have these details, I can approach Northmere Mutual for a quotation.

Kind regards,
Erin Cole
Alderbrook Cover
